title: Sessions slower than their database average
description: Using a correlated subquery, return active sessions whose duration_sec is strictly greater than the average duration_sec of all active sessions for the same database_name. Return exactly three columns: session_id, database_name, duration_sec. Sort by database_name ASC, duration_sec DESC, session_id ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT s.id AS session_id, s.database_name, s.duration_sec
FROM sessions AS s
hints: The inner AVG must filter state = active and correlate by database_name.
The outer query must also keep only active sessions.
solution_explanation: Correlation recalculates the baseline separately for the database of each outer row.
